payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a user behavior analytics dashboard. Use: funnel visualization, user flow diagrams (Sankey), conversion metrics, engagement heatmaps, cohort tables, retention curves, session replay indicators.
payload.best_for: Conversion funnel analysis, user journey tracking, engagement analytics, cohort analysis, retention tracking
payload.css_technical_keywords: SVG funnel with gradients, Sankey diagram library, percentage labels, cohort grid cells, retention chart (line/area), click heatmap overlay, session timeline
payload.do_not_use_for: Real-time operational metrics, technical system monitoring, financial transactions
payload.effects_and_animation: Funnel animation (fill-down), flow diagram animations (connection draw), conversion pulse, engagement bar fill
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Funnel stages clear, ☐ Flow diagram readable, ☐ Conversions calculated, ☐ Cohorts comparable, ☐ Retention trends visible, ☐ Privacy compliant
payload.keywords: Funnel visualization, user flow diagrams, conversion tracking, engagement metrics, user journey mapping, cohort analysis
payload.primary_colors: Funnel stage colors: high engagement (green), drop-off (red), conversion (blue), user flow arrows (grey)
payload.secondary_colors: Stage completion colors (success), abandonment colors (warning), engagement levels (gradient), cohort colors
